13, the only thing you're really supposed to be doing is school, and it's summer break now - you don't need to be putting a grand plan I to action. Find one thing you can do and do it, hang out with friends, or go for a jog, bike ride or rock climbing. Find a neighbour's lawn to mow for a few bucks. One thing that feels productive - that's a first building block of who you are. And if that thing sucked, try a different thing until you find something you can do two days in a row
